driver_desc: A virtual audio device that other apps use as a microphone. Installing asks for your password and restarts audio for a second.
banner_install: Add Soundpad Virtual Mic so others hear them too. One-time setup, asks for your password.

blackhole_credit: Based on the open-source BlackHole driver by Existential Audio (GPL-3.0).
